title: Fototeca Piemonte — Historical aerial photography index of Piedmont, Italy (Portolan mirror)
description: Vector index of the historical aerial photography archive of Regione Piemonte, Italy: 524 flights and 70,065 frames from 1944 to 2011, published as a Portolan catalog. Four GeoParquet collections — flight extents, frame ground footprints, flight axes and camera stations — with year, scale, altitude and links to the original images. Unofficial mirror of a CC BY 4.0 dataset produced by Regione Piemonte. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Regione Piemonte.
